test_MNIST: test the MNIST dataset builder using MNISTTest class with train and test splits
test_FashionMNIST: test the FashionMNIST dataset builder using FashionMNISTTest class inheriting MNISTTest
test_KMNIST: test the KMNIST dataset builder using KMNISTTest class inheriting MNISTTest
test_EMNIST: test the EMNIST dataset builder with custom test config using EMNISTTest class
run_mnist_tests: run all mnist dataset tests via testing.test_main() entry point
